author: Scopoli, 1786
habitat: 바닷가 섬, 숲 가장자리와 농경지 같은 트인 곳
summary: 2016년 5월 1일 통영 소매물도에서 어린새 한 마리가 확인된 것이 국내 첫 기록인 길잃은새로, 이 종이 기록된 가장 북쪽이기도 하다. 인도 북동부에서 중국 남부, 동남아시아, 필리핀, 인도네시아에 걸쳐 살며, 중국 남부의 무리는 여름에 와서 번식하고 겨울에는 남쪽으로 내려간다. 숲 가장자리와 농경지, 공원 같은 트인 곳에서 애벌레 같은 무척추동물을 먹고, 재봉새·개개비사촌·프리니아류의 둥지에 탁란한다.

points.en: grey head, throat and upper breast (male)
unmarked orange-buff lower breast and belly (male)
rufous-brown upperparts barred black, whitish underparts with narrow dark bars (hepatic female)

sexes.male: 머리와 멱, 윗가슴은 회색이고 등과 날개는 회갈색이며, 아랫가슴과 배는 무늬 없는 주황빛 갈색이다.
sexes.female: 수컷과 비슷하나 배에 흰 가로무늬가 있는 회색형과, 윗면이 적갈색이고 온몸에 검은 가로무늬가 있는 적색형이 있다.

young: 적색형 암컷과 비슷하나 더 옅고, 정수리와 목, 가슴에 가로무늬 대신 짙은 세로줄무늬가 있다.

art.subject: Plaintive Cuckoo (Cacomantis merulinus), adult male: head, nape and upper breast grey, palest on the throat and breast; mantle, back and wing coverts dark grey to grey-brown; flight feathers darker brown; lower breast, belly and undertail coverts plain rufous-orange without bars, paler buff towards the vent; tail dark grey-brown, graduated, with white tips and white notches on the outer feathers. Bill black, slender and slightly decurved; iris reddish-brown; legs yellow.
art.pose: perched on a bare twig in the open, side view
art.scene: Shrubby woodland edge on a Korean offshore island in May, during spring migration, bright morning light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched upright on a bare twig: grey head, throat and upper breast, red iris, short slender slightly decurved black bill with a yellowish base, grey-brown upperparts and wings, unmarked orange-buff lower breast and belly, long graduated grey-brown tail tipped white, short yellow legs
adult hepatic female, side view perched on a twig: rufous-brown upperparts barred black, whitish underparts with narrow dark bars, long graduated tail, slender bill, yellow legs
art.build: Small, slim cuckoo, a little smaller than a Brown-eared Bulbul, with a longish graduated tail and pointed wings. Bill short, slender and slightly decurved. Legs short, yellow, with two toes forward and two back. Perches upright, often in the open on bare twigs. Females may resemble the male or be hepatic: rufous-brown above and whitish below, closely barred dark all over.
avoid: Do not bar the belly; the male's lower underparts are plain rufous-orange, unlike the barred white belly of Lesser Cuckoo (Cuculus poliocephalus).
Do not paint a grey belly (Grey-bellied Cuckoo, Cacomantis passerinus).
Do not paint a heavy bill or a large, hawk-like body.
